repos_data.description: Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for Atlassian Confluence. Provides tools enabling AI systems (LLMs) to list/get spaces & pages (content formatted as Markdown) and search via CQL. Connects AI seamlessly to Confluence knowledge bases using the standard MCP interface.
Universal MCP-Server for your Databases optimized for LLMs and AI-Agents.
🔥 Official Firecrawl MCP Server - Adds powerful web scraping and search to Cursor, Claude and any other LLM clients.

K8s-mcp-server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants like Claude to securely execute Kubernetes commands. It provides a bridge between language models and essential Kubernetes CLI tools including kubectl, helm, istioctl, and argocd, allowing AI systems to assist with cluster management, troubleshooting, and deployments
Message queue for AI coding assistants. Let your AI agents talk to each other.

Self-hosted, open-source AI-empowered MCP gateway: turn any API, database or MCP server into custom connectors for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot & Cursor — no code. Convert REST, SOAP, WSDL, GraphQL & SQL to MCP, with OAuth2, RBAC & audit log. 175+ pre-built adapters (Deutsche Bahn, weclapp, Etsy, DHL, Shopware…)
Official remote MCP server for the Sevalla public API.
MCP server for the Sovereign AI Blog: Search, retrieve, and diagnose tools for self-hosted AI on NVIDIA DGX Spark.
Published in CNCF Landscape: A MCP server for Kubernetes.
Universal MCP gateway for AI agents — 1250 tools, 354 providers. One endpoint (https://apibase.pro/mcp), pay-per-call with x402 USDC on Base + MPP USDC on Tempo.
CLI & MCP server for Tuning Engines — fine-tune LLMs on code repositories
